chart.title: Output and persistent-queue errors by destination

search.query: index=cribl_internal source=cribl `homelab_error_terms` | spath input=_raw output=cribl_channel path=channel | search cribl_channel="output*" OR cribl_channel="DestPQ*" | eval cribl_destination=replace(cribl_channel, "^[^:]+:", "") | search cribl_destination="$destination$" | timechart span=5m count by cribl_destination limit=10
